verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say it can register on your behalf (stripe-tax-docs-14) and encourage registering as soon as you start processing payments (stripe-tax-docs-8). Registrations can be managed in the Dashboard Locations tab or via the Tax Registrations API (stripe-tax-docs-18), and nexus monitoring flags where you may need to register (stripe-tax-docs-17, stripe-tax-docs-7). However, the registration service gets only a single thin mention. missing for 10: transparent per-registration pricing, status tracking of in-progress registration applications, explicit coverage of local (not just state) registrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the register-on-your-behalf service.
